paper.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale

result.summary: 本文提出 Vision Transformer（ViT），将图像切分为固定大小的 patch 序列，直接输入标准 Transformer 编码器进行图像分类，几乎不引入图像特有的归纳偏置 [S1.p3][S5.p1]。作者发现，在中型数据集（如 ImageNet）上训练时 ViT 精度略低于同规模 ResNet [S1.p4]，但在大规模数据（14M–300M 图像）上预训练后，ViT 在多个图像识别基准上接近或超过当时的最优卷积网络，且预训练所需计算资源更少 [S1.p5][S4.SS2.p2]。论文还通过预训练数据规模、模型规模、注意力可视化及自监督等实验分析了 ViT 的特性 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p2][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，而此前视觉中的自注意力要么与卷积结合，要么替换卷积网络的某些组件但保留整体结构 [abstract][S1.p1][S1.p2]。作者希望以尽可能少的修改，把图像当作 patch 序列处理，验证纯 Transformer 在大规模预训练下能否与最优卷积网络竞争 [S1.p3][S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: In vision, attention is either applied in conjunction with convolutional networks, or used to replace certain components of convolutional networks while keeping their overall structure in place.
Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
our work goes further to demonstrate that large scale pre-training makes vanilla transformers competitive with (or even better than) state-of-the-art CNNs.

method.text: ViT 将图像 \(\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}\) 切分为固定大小的二维 patch，展平后经可训练线性投影映射到维度 \(D\)，得到 patch embeddings [S3.SS1.p1]。与 BERT 类似，序列前加入一个可学习的 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。模型加入可学习的一维位置嵌入，编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个 block 前用 LayerNorm、后接残差连接 [S3.SS1.p3][S3.SS1.p4]。微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化的 \(D\times K\) 前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做二维插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
we flatten the patches and map to $D$ dimensions with a trainable linear projection (Eq. 1).
Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
We therefore perform 2D interpolation of the pre-trained position embeddings, according to their location in the original image.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像），并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与 patch 大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型将 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。此外还进行了预训练数据规模实验、JFT-300M 上的受控 scaling 研究、注意力分析以及掩码 patch 预测的自监督初步实验 [S4.SS3.p2][S4.SS4.p1][S4.SS5.p3][S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.
We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096
For fine-tuning we use SGD with momentum, batch size 512, for all models
First, we pre-train ViT models on datasets of increasing size: ImageNet, ImageNet-21k, and JFT-300M.
We perform a controlled scaling study of different models by evaluating transfer performance from JFT-300M.
We also perform a preliminary exploration on masked patch prediction for self-supervision

findings.text: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在所有任务上超过同样在该数据集上预训练的 BiT-L，且所需计算资源显著更少；更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务上 77.63% [S1.p5]。在预训练数据规模实验中，ViT 在小型数据集上不如 BiT ResNet，但随着数据增大而反超，且更大的 ViT 变体随数据增长超过较小变体 [S4.F4][S4.SS3.p2]。受控 scaling 研究表明，ViT 在性能/计算权衡上优于 ResNet，达到相同性能约少用 2–4 倍计算；混合模型在小计算预算下略优于纯 ViT，但差距随模型增大而消失 [S4.SS4.p2]。注意力分析显示，部分注意力头在最低层就关注图像大部分区域，注意力距离随网络深度增加，模型关注与分类语义相关的区域 [S4.SS5.p3]。自监督掩码 patch 预测使 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍比监督预训练低 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

evidence.quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
The larger model, ViT-H/14, further improves the performance, especially on the more challenging datasets – ImageNet, CIFAR-100, and the VTAB suite.
the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
While large ViT models perform worse than BiT ResNets (shaded area) when pre-trained on small datasets, they shine when pre-trained on larger datasets.
Only with JFT-300M, do we see the full benefit of larger models.
ViT uses approximately $2-4\times$ less compute to attain the same performance (average over 5 datasets).
hybrids slightly outperform ViT at small computational budgets, but the difference vanishes for larger models.
We find that some heads attend to most of the image already in the lowest layers
Further, the attention distance increases with network depth.
Globally, we find that the model attends to image regions that are semantically relevant for classification (Figure 6).
our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在中型数据集（如 ImageNet）上不加强正则化训练时，ViT 精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，并认为这可能是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 固有的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，在数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。作者还指出，将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战，自监督预训练与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距，需要继续探索 [S5.p2]。此外，作者提到预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，还受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
